title: [spec-gap][R-X509-023/024/025/026/027/028] Mesh role X.509 extension codec: OID 2.25.116347725289407359125616919235271862817 + semantics
description: spec/appendix-x509-cert-profile.md section 5: custom extension in the 2.25 UUID arc (OID 2.25.116347725289407359125616919235271862817, from UUIDv5 5787c1be-467b-5e51-92c4-77bcaeb02a21); MUST NOT be critical; BIT STRING named bits leaf/relay/gateway, unspecified bits MUST be zero; extension MUST be omitted (not empty) for no-role certs; empty BIT STRING if present MUST be treated as unasserted; verifiers not implementing it MUST ignore it; authorization MUST NOT treat absence as leaf.
